title: ever CAMILLE|Elegant Lace A-Line Long Sleeves Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Elegant Lace A-Line Long Sleeves Midi Wedding Guest Dress. This refined dress features an A-line silhouette that flatters every figure and is adorned with intricate lace detailing. The long sleeves add a touch of sophistication, while the midi length ensures a graceful look. Perfect for wedding guests who desire a classic and stylish ensemble for the special day.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
